title: 谁不是恐龙
subtitle: 会飞的、游泳的，都不算
character: wearing a brick red t-shirt, olive shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen and ink lines with light washes, muted olive, brick red and warm grey

pages.zh:
我指着天上挂的那只说，
这也是恐龙。
爸爸摇摇头。
它会飞，
可它真的不是恐龙。
pages.scene: The little boy in a museum points up at a large flying reptile model hanging from the ceiling, his father standing beside him.

pages.zh:
怎么分呢？
看腿。
恐龙的腿
直直地长在身体下面，
像四根柱子撑着。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one animal body seen from the front on a cream background with its four legs running straight down underneath it like four posts. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
蜥蜴和鳄鱼不一样。
它们的腿
是朝两边撇出去的，
走起路来
身体左右扭。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one animal body seen from the front on a cream background with its four legs bent out sideways away from the body. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
天上飞的那种叫翼龙。
它的翅膀，
是一根特别长的手指
撑起来的一张皮。
它不是恐龙。
pages.scene: One flying reptile gliding with its wing membrane stretched from one very long finger, on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
翅膀有三种做法。
翼龙用一根手指撑，
蝙蝠用四根手指撑，
鸟用羽毛铺。
各有各的办法。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three wing outlines in a row on a cream background, the first with one very long finger bone, the second with four spread finger bones, the third with layered feathers. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
水里游的那些
也不是恐龙。
有的像一条大蜥蜴，
有的长得像海豚，
可它们都不算。
pages.scene: Two large sea reptiles swimming underwater on a cream background: one long and lizard-like with four paddle flippers, the other with a narrow pointed snout, a smooth streamlined body, four paddle flippers and a large upright tail fin.

pages.zh:
分成三堆就清楚了：
天上飞的翼龙，
水里游的大家伙，
地上走的恐龙。
只有最后一堆才叫恐龙。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: a cream background in three horizontal rows, the top row holding two flying shapes, the middle row two swimming shapes, the bottom row three walking shapes, with a ring drawn around the bottom row only. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
那时候的恐龙
都在陆地上走。
后来有一小支
长出羽毛，飞了起来。
那就是鸟。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur lifting off from the ground on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以鸟
反过来是恐龙。
窗外的麻雀，
院子里的鸡，
都是恐龙的后代。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one branching tree drawn on a cream background with a thick trunk marked by a dinosaur silhouette and one branch leading up to a bird silhouette. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
还有一个常弄混的。
长毛的大象
和剑齿虎，
比恐龙晚得多，
那时候恐龙早就没了。
pages.scene: One woolly mammoth and one sabre-toothed cat standing on snowy ground on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
把时间排一排
就清楚了。
先是恐龙，
中间隔了好久好久，
才轮到长毛象，最后是我们。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one long horizontal timeline on a cream background with three marks placed far apart along it, a dinosaur shape at the first, a mammoth shape at the second and a small human shape at the third. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我又看了一眼
天上挂的那只。
它不是恐龙。
可它和恐龙，
是一个时候的邻居。
pages.scene: The little boy looks up once more at the hanging flying reptile model, thoughtful, one hand on the railing.
